opening.argument: The video centers on displaying a $25 Visa gift card and reciting its printed details: the speaker says, “Now today I'm gonna show y'all my Visa gift card. You know what I'm saying? $25 gift card,” then adds, “So here's the digits.” The title uses “Free visa gift card,” but neither the presentation nor the surrounding material states that viewers must pay, provide credentials, or complete a transaction. That wording is not tied to a deceptive mechanism or audience financial participation, so the observable purpose remains an ordinary gift-card or promotional presentation.
